data.name: Ezekiel
data.gender_notes: Ezekiel is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Yeḥezqel: ḥazaq, 'to strengthen', + El, 'God'. Its root is Hebrew ḥ-z-q-ʾ-l. The prophet Ezekiel; the Book of Ezekiel. Ezekiel is a Hebrew name meaning “God strengthens”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ezekiel expresses “God strengthens”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Yeḥezqel: ḥazaq, 'to strengthen', + El, 'God'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ezekiel total 37, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
